title: Néron lft-model of a group scheme
statement: Let $D$ be a domain, $E=\operatorname{Frac}(D)$ and $S=\operatorname{Spec}D$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Let $V$ be an $E$-group scheme and $N$ an $S$-group scheme [def-sc-group-scheme, def-pc-scheme], and specify an isomorphism of $E$-groups $e:N_E\simeq V$, where $N_E$ is the canonical base change [def-pc-base-change]. The predicate that $(N,e)$ is a Néron lft-model of $V$ means that $N\to S$ is smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], its diagonal is a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], and for every smooth $S$-scheme $X$ the canonical restriction $\operatorname{Hom}_S(X,N)\to\operatorname{Hom}_E(X_E,V)$, $f\mapsto e\circ f_E$, is bijective. Smoothness implies locally of finite type in the sense of [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]; no quasi-compactness is required. Over Dedekind domains this is the group-scheme specialization of BLR 10.1 Definition 1.

source.place: BLR 10.1 Definition 1, printed p.289 (PDF p.295), with Néron mapping property from 1.2 Definition 1, printed p.12 (PDF p.18); primary scan https://www.math.stonybrook.edu/~kamenova/homepage_files/Bosch_Raynaud_Neron_Model_tc.pdf

    [Algebra D E] [IsFractionRing D E]
    (N : Grp (Over (Spec (.of D)))) (V : Grp (Over (Spec (.of E))))
